Take a shelter dog hiking

Shelter dogs love the trail as much as you do. These programs let you take an adoptable dog for a hike, a run or a long walk, then share photos that help them get adopted.

Good to know

Can anyone hike with a shelter dog?

Many programs are open to the public with an ID and waiver; some trail programs are for trained volunteers. Each listing says who can go.

Where can I take the dog?

Usually anywhere dogs are allowed on leash. Most shelters ask you to avoid dog parks.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.

Ready to adopt? ShelterAdoption, our sister site, lists every shelter near you plus upcoming adoption events.
